name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, a welcome distraction from her corporate IT background. After building and managing systems for large financial institutions in Mumbai, she sought a faster-paced environment, craving the tangible results of real-world engineering and data. The speed and data volume of motorsport were instantly appealing. 

At Trident, Priya leads the IT infrastructure, ensuring seamless data flow between the track, factory, and management. Her pragmatic approach focuses on robust, reliable systems, prioritizing immediate needs while strategically planning for future expansion. She's known for her hands-on troubleshooting and ability to explain complex technical issues in plain language, bridging the gap between the engineering and IT departments. What sets Priya apart is her dedication to mentoring junior engineers, guiding them through the practical challenges of real-time data management in a demanding environment.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly braided and coiled into a bun at the nape of her neck, with a few strands escaping to frame her face.
physical.description: Priya has a warm, intelligent face, often framed by her dark, braided hair.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten system diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using keyboard shortcuts for everything, even when a mouse would be faster.
